full_inspection: Compared all four native halves line by line, including every formula, underline, footnote, two question marks, enclosing oval and margins. The body typing agrees; only the three copy2 marks and distinct archive foliations differ.
original_transcription_comparison: Compared both complete original transcriptions. The two added question marks and changed foliation match the scans. The original circle comment is accurate but omits that the full stop also lies inside; this is precisely encoded with separate ink layers.

entries.decision: retain the upper handwritten question mark at its line anchor
entries.reason: Its curved head, descending stroke and separate point are legible in copy2; the corresponding copy1 margin is blank.

entries.decision: retain typed contents and mark only the enclosing oval as handwriting
entries.reason: Copy2 has a freehand oval around the typed parentheses, asterisk and final full stop; copy1 has the same typed characters without that stroke.

entries.decision: retain the lower handwritten question mark at the footnote anchor
entries.reason: The large question mark is clear in copy2 and absent from the matching copy1 margin.

entries.decision: retain both archive foliations without author attribution
entries.reason: The two distinct handwritten numerals are clear.
